Allow this session to perform the registered APK tool workflow described below on the selected whole iPhone. Android owns USB; your terminal receives no raw FD, pairing data or keys. This is not permission for arbitrary programs or arbitrary IPA installation. Account input and certificate revocation require separate decisions.

isideload scope: download fixed official SideStore stable; manage developer-team device/App IDs/certificates/profiles; sign and install; generate pairing and place it in app Documents. Canceling does not roll back an installed app or an explicitly revoked certificate.
idevice-check scope: check private mux streams and device enumeration. No signing or app installation.
